scope_note: Different administration/session than the already-piloted MCAS batch (that pilot used a different release cycle/items). Content strands: Earth and Space Science, Life Science, Physical Science, Technology/Engineering. Earth and Space Science items (rock/erosion, climate, solar energy) are the best fit for filling the space/science content gap noted in the source catalog.
extracted_items_note: 20 released operational items with correct answers (items 1-20, Session 1 + Session 2) captured below. Several are constructed-response (CR) with no single fixed answer (items 7, 10, 17) -- deferred, not usable in our MCQ schema. Several selected-response items reference a diagram/graph essential to answering (e.g. item 1 rock arch photo, item 5 climate-based erosion match, item 9 balloon force diagram, item 20 dog-breeding picture) -- these are usable if the diagram's essential info is restated as text in the rewritten item (the diagrams mostly encode facts already stated in the prose, e.g. 'the balloon moved left' or 'birds prey on snails, snails eat grass'). Item 20 is multi-select (select two) -- schema requires single correct option, so it needs restructuring to a single-answer MCQ, not a direct port.
